batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b UT Yadav

batting.dismissal: c PJ Cummins b GB Hogg

batting.name: MM Sharma
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b AD Russell

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c RG More b MM Sharma

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b P Negi

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b RG More

balls.text: 141kph, swishes at the length delivery outside off but Nehra calls for one and they complete the bye
in the block hole, More blocks it very close to the stumps and reacts a bit late as Nehra wants one
slower delivery outside off, Nehra pokes and manages an outside edge to third man for one more
fullish outside off, driven down to long off for one
angles it in sharply towards the pads, Nehra missed and they take a leg bye as the ball went towards third man for one. Uthappa appealed but Russell did not

starts with a slower ball and gets his second wicket! Mohit slogged the length delivery to the leg side, mistimed it completely and got a very high edge which Uthappa got under by running towards short leg. Took it comfortably
the wrong one to end the over from off stump, Nehra stretched forward a long way to defend and was beaten by the ball that turned away

that's the quicker one from Hoggy and he knocks the off stump! The flatter delivery came in from just outside off, Negi tried to cut it off the back foot but was beaten by the pace and his bat came down late
this man is unfazed, he dances down the track with some room and lofts it with an inside-out drive over the covers with turn for six!
flighted on leg, Jadeja sweeps it hard but can't clear the tall man Cummins. He got a fullish delivery, went down on a knee and swept the ball, but holed out to deep midwicket. Hogg's third wicket
comes down the track and turns the ball before it turns to the leg side for one
slow and flighted around leg, he defends it back
pitches it up now on leg stump, Negi chips it down to long on for one

take that, you can't bowl short to him! Took his front foot out of the way again, absolutely smoked that with a pull and deep midwicket couldn't move this time. A slight nod form Negi after hitting that one
slow and short at 106kph, the result is the same! Negi opened up when he saw the slower ball, waited and then pulled it wide of midwicket and even deep midwicket for four yet again
on the leg side now, he tries to run it down to fine leg and manages it off his hips for four leg byes
hammers it this time on the off side, one-bounce four! Got a full delivery on the off side, he cleared his front foot and struck it hard over the covers for four
pokes at the length delivery angles across him outside off, he doesn't connect
defends the short ball near the off stump and Jadeja responds for the quick single
fuller now outside off and he dabs it square on the off side to deep point for two
short ball around off, Negi is in an uncomfortable position and reacts a bit late to edge fine on the off side to get four. Lucky runs for him

the slower one finally does it, Bravo misses it completely! It was the slower offcutter from just outside off, Bravo played it early and let one hand go off the bat when he realised he didn't pick it, and the ball knocked over the off stump
tries the yorker and Jadeja steers the low full toss to deep midwicket for one
slower ball at 119kph on the stumps, pretty full, and Jads blocks it back
and another short ball, towards the batsman's shoulders, and he pulls it to deep square leg
slower bouncer at 104kph, Bravo pivots on the back foot, waits and pulls to deep midwicket
145kmh, another short ball and Jadeja pulls it past midwicket
slow offcutter outside off, he runs it down to third man for one

that's gone high on the leg side, Gambhir is running backwards and he puts it down! Bravo pulled the short ball and got a top edge, Gambhir was running from midwicket but it never looked like he was going to get under it properly
short ball towards the ribs, Jadeja defends it softly towards short leg and they sneak in a quick single
helped to the third man boundary as he weaves his torso inside the line of a short ball and ramps it away
shortish on middle and leg, seems the slower one as well, offcutter nudged behind square leg
leaps off his feet to get on top of a short ball on off stump, dabbed towards point for a quick single
goes short and causes Bravo to duck under it
back of a length and outside off, he waits for it better this time and pushes to cover point
trouble with pace at the other end, with Russell making a short ball hold up. Bravo was looking for a flick, and gets a leading edge that goes a few feet to the right of the bowler

had the chance to free his arms and Jaddu nails it! Front foot pushes forward, but is stowed away from the line of the ball to enable the big swing of the bat. Gets to the pitch and lifts it with every bit of power he had
"Catch it," was a cry as Jaddu plays outside the line of a googly. No bat involved even as Uthappa runs past short leg to get to it
a shade flatter and sliding outside off, Bravo moves away from it and cuts to deep point
oh, he's offered on in the slot and Bravo accepts. Hammered down the ground with typical flourish
huge inside edge off a googly, because Bravo was making room having not picked it. The ball dribbles away to slip
flighted on off stump, and it rips in quite sharply. Bravo attempts a tickle into the leg side but only manages an inside edge onto pad
he looks to pull the short ball, doesn't time it well and can't clear midwicket
short of length delivery outside off, he dabs it to cover
offcutter outside off, Bravo pushes it down towards midwicket and a misfield from Yusuf gives them one
even shorter on the leg side, Jadeja tucks it to deep square leg this time
back of length on the leg stump, he defends it to midwicket
length delivery outside off, Bravo tries to hammer it on off but gets an inner edge to deep midwicket
towards middle and leg now, much fuller and Bravo drives it with the turn to long on
swishes at the length delivery well outside off, he swings and misses
shorter ball turning away, he rocks back and pulls it to long on for one
touch wider outside off, sends it to deep cover this time for one
turning in from length outside off, driven straight to cover
fullish on the middle stump, Jadeja drives it down to long on for one
length ball, another googly and Bravo watches it carefully before blocking it back
that's the googly again turning in, appeal for lbw but it struck him just outside off, the ball then rolls away past the keeper for another four. Chawla doesn't like it
tossed up outside off, Bravo presses forward and defends on off
turning in this time slightly from outside off, Bravo defends to cover point and is sent back for the single
sharp turn outside the off stump, Bravo was surprised by the turn and got a thick outside edge and he beats short third man again
fullish on the off stump, helped to mid on with the turn and a misfield from Pandey there concedes a single
outside the off stump now, Jadeja waits and cuts off the back foot to deep point
length delivery on leg stump, he defends on the leg side
turning in from around off, driven with the turn to long on

this one closer to off stump, still a bit of room, and Bravo guides it late past the slip region fine on the off side. Hogg ran a long way from short third man and put in a slide but couldn't get there
he goes back to let it turn and slices it to point
slides it in towards leg stump, Jadeja dabs it to leg off the back foot
bit of room now and he pushes the ball with the turn to long on
doesn't move much, waits for the ball to turn into him a little bit and defends on the off side
presses forward and blocks the ball back before it turns
that beats everyone - the bat, the off stump and the keeper! The googly turned away from middle and off, Jads offered a straight bat but that beauty turned away to make everyone jump with excitement
flighted on middle and leg, driven with the turn to midwicket
leans forward and blocks the ball back to the bowler

the other one again, was there an edge, the reaction of Hogg, Uthappa and Gambhir says so! It went the other way from outside off, was on length, and Bravo played for the chinaman but it beat him and got an outside edge that Uthappa put down
touch fuller outside off, there's room as it turns away and Jads cuts it to deep point
bit too short around off, it turns away and Jadeja goes back to whip the ball between mid on and midwicket for four
lots of flight outside off, full again, Jadeja gets a thick edge as he tries to slam it to midwicket
fullish outside off, driven down tentatively to long off
loud loud appeal, another wrong one as Jadeja leans forward to defend but the ball struck him outside off
outside the off stump, not much turn and Jadeja pushes it down to long off for one

one more, Chawla bowls Dhoni with a googly! It came in sharply from outside off, Dhoni went in the crease to steer the ball to the leg side and the ball stayed low to find the gap between bat and pad. The crowd is loving this!
slides in a slightly quicker one, Bravo goes back as it doesn't bounce much and he dabs it to midwicket
fullish on middle and leg now, driven against the turn to leg for one
tossed up outside off, pushed back to the bowler with the turn
lbw appeal again, it pitched around leg and was turning just a bit, hit in front of leg and they sneak in a leg bye. Good appeal, wasn't that far away

very very loud appeal for lbw from all six KKR players around the batsmen, but turned down! This one came into the batsman as Dhoni went on the back foot, but it turned a bit too much and was going down as Dhoni was struck in front of leg. Good decision

second wicket of the over, the wrong one has done it! Faf walked down, tried to steer it with the spin to the leg side, but the ball went the other way from around off and beat him completely. Uthappa does the rest
that's too full and Faf charges down too, takes it as a full toss, and slams it down the ground between long on and long off for a four
turns it in towards off stump from outside off, Faf goes back and pushes to cover
slower and fuller around off, Bravo drives it with the turn towards mid on

he's got him first ball, the 44-year-old has struck straightaway! He started with a flat delivery on the stumps, short of length, Baz pulled and missed it and was struck right in front. Maybe he thought it was too high and wasn't that happy. Looked plumb in replays
googly turning in, Faf makes room but gets an edge to the leg side
makes a lot of room, gets a full delivery and drives it with the spin on the off side again. To the cover boundary for four
can't middle it this time, came down to steer the ball to leg but took it on the body
uses his feet now, gets four more! He came down to take the ball on the full and drove it handsomely to the other side of cover and even beats long off
in the air, but in the gap for four! Chawla gave a lot of flight for the full delivery on middle, he made some room and drove it inside-out in the gap between cover and cover point
another one-bounce four for Baz! He gave the charge, picked the ball from middle stump and cleared mid-on by lofting it straight down to long on for four
slides it towards the batsman again, near the hips and it deflects down to fine leg for a leg bye
fullish and angling in, he steers the ball and uses the pace to flick past Russell at midwicket off the back foot. Great timing to collect four
he's handed it straight to mid-on, Raina gone! Umesh pitched it up, looks like Raina wanted to clear the infield but he merely chipped it to Chawla's right at mid on. He didn't have to move much
gives a bit of room, tries to swipe the short ball over the slips but misses
Raina pulls the short ball, doesn't middle it well but the quick outfield and Powerplay mean whatever he got on that was enough to collect four
slower one again, cutting in and Baz tucks it off the back foot towards deep square leg for two
he's targetting the V - but behind the wicket! Charged down the ground, Cummins replied with a short ball outside off but Baz got room and cut that well over third man for six
shortish offcutter again, Baz waited and then swat-pulled it to midwicket
short ball at 139kph, Baz moves his arms like a boxer and hammers that to the fine leg boundary for a one-bounce four. That crossed the rope in no time
slower offcutter going down the leg side, Baz merely helps it along the way to beat the keeper and fine leg both, four off the glove
good bounce again for Cummins, short ball rising on Baz, he goes back and defends awkwardly, taking one hand off the bat
outside off from back of length, Raina stays back and pokes to guide it to third man, but misses
length delivery angled across outside off, no movement, Raina drives it to extra cover
full outside off now, Raina looked to push into the covers and got a thick edge to point
straighter delivery on middle and off, Raina goes across and tucks the ball to midwicket
just back of length outside off, Raina goes on his toes and defends to point
starts with a fullish delivery outside off and Raina caresses it all along the ground with a beautiful cover drive for four
beaten outside off! Some good bounce for Cummins with that short of length delivery, McCullum poked and missed the ball for the keeper
another wide, this time a slower one down the leg side
on the charge now, he's not under any pressure, and tonks that by taking it on the full from off stump straight down the ground over long off for another six! The audacity after being 0 for 1
errs down the leg side, just past the pads and the keeper misses it too. Five wides

that's how Baz opens his account, six runs! He gets room with the back of length delivery outside off, swings his arms and swivels the bat for a six over the covers. The ball boy catches it near the boundary
full on the off stump, bit of shape, and Baz pushes it down gently to mid on
futile lbw appeal as it hit Raina full on the pads and was swinging down leg, they get a leg bye

that's a blinder first ball, Smith gone for a golden duck! It was pretty wide outside the off stump, Smith chased the delivery with a swipe uppishly and ten Doeschate flew to his left from cover point to gab it with both hands. The crowd erupts even more
full toss on the stumps and a thick inside edge runs down to the fine-leg boundary for four. Dhoni and More appealed for lbw, but the edge went through Russell's legs. Fist pump from Uthappa
full and straight now, Uthappa drives it down firmly to long off
almost a yorker again, but Uthappa makes room and drives it straight down handsomely, Raina runs from long on and they take two
right in the block hole on leg stump, Russell steers it to deep midwicket. Only one
comes down for the full delivery and drives it down to long off for one
slower bouncer at 117.6kph outside off, Russell came down and pulled with a lot of power but missed it completely
full and wide again, swinging away, and Russell finds point with his drive
slower delivery at 104kph, it was wide too and Russell swung his bat wildly but could not middle it
short ball outside off is slapped down the ground to long off
that's a full toss with width, tried the yorker maybe, and Uthappa pounced on it by lofting it over the covers with a drive, in the gap
bit of swing for the length delivery outside off, Uthappa drives but doesn't middle it
yorker again, Uthappa comes down again and pushes it to long on for one

great cricket all around! Uthappa took a step down and pushed the yorker down firmly towards long on. Raina ran to his left from long on and slided to cut the ball and threw it to Faf who came from long off
full delivery on middle is steered straight to midwicket
full again, he flicks it along the ground and finer on leg, Mohit runs around and slides to keep it to two
falls just short of deep square leg! Uthappa flicked the ball off the pads towards Mohit Sharma, who ran in hard, but the ball dipped on him and they take two
tries the yorker and Russell flicks the ball off the back foot to the leg side
on length outside off, Russell drives it easily on off for one
this one's fuller and this one's even bigger! On the stumps at 134kph, Russell bludgeons it like a rocket squarer on the leg side for a massive six. That's his fifty
this time the slower ball is full, an offcutter on the stumps, and Russell swung his arms to flick it high in the air and well over deep midwicket for six
slightly slower at 127.6kph, it's pretty wide and Russell chases but missed. Just inside the wide line
low full toss on off, pushed down easily to long off. A fumble from Faf nearly made them come back for the second
angles the ball sharply towards Russell's abdomen, he defends on leg for one
full on the stumps, easy drive down the ground to long on
he makes room and cuts the ball from middle stump towards point. Happy to give the strike to Russell
full outside off, Russell leans into it, goes down on a knee and drives firmly for one
he's turning it into KKR's favour! Makes room and hammers the ball from outside leg, this time over the long on fielder for a clean six
such force he uses, fielders don't get time to react! He didn't have any room, it as on leg stump and somehow slammed it just wide of long on for four
makes room for the full delivery and chips the ball dangerously down the ground, it lands just before long off
touch back of length outside off, Russell looks to slice it but the bounce beats him
fullish outside off, he pushes the ball gently into the covers by leaning into it and calls for one
full and straight on the stumps, Uthappa defends it back
he's aware of the fielding change and this time cuts the back of length ball from outside off between point and short third man for four more!
just outside off with the angle and Uthappa smartly guides the ball, using the pace, and beats third man by helping it fine
and he's greeted with a six that flew over his head to the long on boundary! Nehra pitched it up, and Uthappa slammed is straight down the ground from the middle of the bat
guides the slow ball from well outside off to short third man, Mohit throws the ball at keeper's end but Russell makes it. No direct hit either
fuller delivery on the stumps, flicked to the leg side for two in the gap
loud lbw appeal for the slow offcutter that came in, Uthappa was on the move to turn it to leg and was hit above the knee roll in front of the stumps
on length now outside off, Russell drives it calmly to sweeper cover for one, 100 up
he throws his bat at this one too outside off, gets a thick outside edge and it flies over short third man for four more
starts well outside off with a short delivery and Russell cuts it fiercely past point and wide of third man for one
charges down the track and drives the full ball to long on for one
appeal for lbw as Russell slogs on the leg side, maybe got an inside edge
takes a step down to take it on the full and gets one to long on again
on the stumps and he slams it down to long on
he makes room and drives the full ball firmly to long off
low full toss on middle, driven down to long on for one
in the block hole on off, Russell digs it out to long off
wants to work the ball to leg but mistimes it and the edge goes to cover for one
makes room early and gets some width too, he waits for the ball to turn and cuts it late to beat short third man for four
pretty full on the off stump, Uthappa defends it back
back of length and flat outside off, he punches it to point where Baz fumbles a bit. Yes, you read that right
slogs it from outside the off stump, weird sound from the bat, but he found the gap between long on and deep midwicket and got four
flat again, this time towards leg stump and Russell helps it behind square on leg for one
slides the flatter one towards the stumps, he blocks it back
charges down, takes it on the full and clobbers it inside-out over the covers for a big six!
draws the outside edge as Uthappa looked to turn the ball to leg from middle stump, but the ball took the edge and went towards cover point
fuller on off stump, no room at all and Russell drives it down to long off
bit of flight outside off, pushed back to the bowler
back of length outside off, he punches it off the back foot to cover for one
errs down the leg side this time and it's a wide
touch shorter and towards off again, pushed down towards midwicket for one
angled in towards off stump, Uthappa steers it with the angle to the deep midwicket region. There was some hesitation for the second, especially from Russell, but they got there
takes a step down and chips the full delivery from middle and leg wide of long on for two more
another top-edge, this one lands safe! Uthappa flicked the back of length ball to leg, didn't time it and it just cleared Nehra at midwicket

it's More's first IPL wicket, he gets Suryakumar! The bowler angled in a length delivery and the batsman targeted the leg side, like he always does, and got a top edge that went very high on the off side. Bravo ran to his right from third man and pouched it to follow it with a jig, the crowd likes it
stumping missed! Uthappa came down to drive the full delivery down the ground, the turn ebat him outside off and Dhoni couldn't hold on to the ball. How expensive will this prove to be...
some turn outside off and Suryakumar cuts it in the air over cover point for one
full on middle and leg, Uthappa steers it late and dangerously to fine leg
sweeps the flighted full toss from off to deep backward square leg

holes out to deep midwicket straightaway, Negi strikes! He sent in a short and flat delivery on the leg stump, Pandey went back to pull it from the middle and gave an easy and straightforward catch to Jadeja
flighted around off, Uthappa leans forward and drives to long off
towards off stump again, easily driven down to long on for one
makes some room and swishes at this one to find deep point for one
fullish and on off stump again, pushed down to long on again
angles in a length delivery towards off, Pandey steers it towards point where Baz dives to his right, doesn't get hold of it and they get one
on length now on the fourth-stump line, Robbie pushes it down to long on for one
tries a yorker and the full delivery on the pads is flicked fine down the leg side by Uthappa for a four
flighted on off, Pandey pushes it to cover. Another dot for him
lbw appeal from Dhoni as Uthappa swept this ball that pitched outside leg and then went for a leg bye down leg
touch fuller outside off and Pandey finally gets a single by steering it into the covers
beaten outside off! Flighted on length and turning away, Pandey poked and missed this one
slightly slower outside off, Uthappa waits and pushes it down to long off
full on the pads now, Uthappa flicks it with the angle to deep backward and a fumble there gives them an easy couple
starts with a wide down the leg side as Uthappa tried to sweep it
another bouncer - this one over the stumps and Pandey ducks under it
length delivery outside off, not much room and Pandey drives it firmly to extra cover
bouncer well down the leg side, that's a wide
touch fuller outside off at 129kph, Pandey pushes it down gently to mid off
beats the batsman by bowling this one across Pandey from length, he simply poked and missed
it didn't stick in Nehra's left hand, put down! Uthappa pulled the short of length ball back to the bowler, Nehra struck his hand out but the ball deflected off the thumb
almost in the block hole, Uthappa loses is balance as he flicks the ball to midwicket
another shot played with too much emphasis on hitting the ball hard. Back of a length slower ball bunted to mid-on
slower ball, directed full and wide. Uthappa has not picked it as he goes for a wild swat into the leg side. Only an inside edge
back of a length, but Uthappa is happy to press forward and punch into the covers
another outside edge as Uthappa pushes hart at the ball. Manages to evade the lone slip fielder, to deep third man

third man's got it! Well, that's at least one outside edge that doesn't sail over the ropes. Good length ball on middle, Gamhir goes for the across-the-line hoick. Instead the ball flies to the other side and is taken smartly on the edge of the boundary
back of a length on off stump, Gambhir uses soft hands to try and dab and run. But Uthappa doesn't want it seeing as the ball went behind the stumps and Dhoni was rushing up for it
flicked away off the pads, long leg does the dirty work
phew! There was no stopping that, runs at the bowler with impudence and hammers a pull over midwicket. Almost like he was venting his frustrations from the last loss
not quite enough room for the slice behind point and Gambhir has to settle for an inside edge to slip

a direct hit brings the third umpire into play. Nudged into the leg side, which leaves Nehra the closest to go after it. Meanwhile the batsmen have scampered across. Good stretch and slide of the bat from Gambhir makes sure he's in

terrific strike! It's the intent that screams louder than anything else in this shot because I think it caught the bottom of the bat. Skips down the track to a back of a length delivery and flat-bats it over mid-off
turned towards short midwicket, and a quick throw from Smith makes sure Gambhir stays his ground at the non-strikers'
too short this time and Gambhir slams it with a pull to the midwicket boundary, goes all the way
back of length and nipping into the batsman, GG doesn't have any room and the ball deflects to slip after hitting his body
length delivery just outside off and Uthappa whips it with his wrists past midwicket for one
angled in towards the stumps, steered to midwicket by Uthappa
slammed back to Mohit, he gets a hand to it but it was very hard to catch it! That was traveling very very fast after GG struck the full delivery in the air and it hit Mohit's wrist
starts with a bouncer on the leg side, Gambhir ducks under it
too full on the pads and going down, he flicks it in the air to fine leg, where Bravo takes it after a bounce
defends the length delivery between midwicket and mid on and they take one
that wasn't too far from the leg stump as Robbie looked to whip it on leg but it went down leg for a wide
superb punch off the back foot for the back of length ball outside off, but finds third man
angled into the pads now, he helps it to fine leg and they come back for two
136kmh, shorter and slightly wider outside off, Gambhir swings and misses
beats Gambhir completely as the ball came in with the angle, he wanted to cut it but the ball beat the inside edge
starts witha wide down the leg side across the pads
that's his area, sliding a short delivery outside off stump past point
points to the bowler. Good length ball teasing Gambhir outside off. He pokes, only to find the ball seaming away past his edge
taps and runs to midwicket, good early call always helps
beautiful timing. Takes a fuller ball from off stump, rolls the wrists at the moment of impact and sends it scurrying through to the midwicket boundary
rides the shortish length with an open face as Uthappa slides a ball with some width towards point
good length ball a shade outside off, Uthappa as he prefers is on the front foot for a push. Only he has offered gap between bat and pad and the inside edge dribbles away behind the stumps
